speaker: Doctor
text: Welcome to the clinic, I am Dr. Agent. You mentioned generalized fatigue, severe itching, and abnormal liver function tests; to begin narrowing down the cause, have you noticed any specific changes in your urine or stool color, or any skin rashes?

speaker: Patient
text: 32-year-old male. The patient reports a 2-month history of increasing generalized fatigue and severe pruritus. He has known hypertension and was diagnosed with ulcerative colitis 5 years ago. He mentions being sexually active with 2 female partners and inconsistent condom use.

speaker: Doctor
text: Given your history of ulcerative colitis and sexual activity with multiple partners, have you noticed any darkening of your urine, clay-colored stools, or a new skin rash? Also, have you experienced any recent fever or weight loss?

speaker: Patient
text: My main symptom is Generalized fatigue and severe pruritus. I also have Scleral icterus, Multiple scratch marks on trunk and extremities.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Primary Biliary Cholangitis (PBC)

The presence of scleral icterus, severe pruritus, and a history of autoimmune disease (ulcerative colitis) strongly suggests an autoimmune liver condition. Please confirm if you have been tested for antimitochondrial antibodies (AMA) and request the corresponding liver ultrasound images to assess for biliary dilation.
